verdict.rationale: OneDrive is a cloud storage service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to expect and the axis applies. The evidence documents only the Microsoft Graph REST API, its metadata, Graph Explorer and a developer sandbox. These are developer building blocks for building agent integrations, not an official MCP server, and nothing in the pack mentions MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
